SELECT employee_id, employee_code, full_name, email, phone_number, gender, birth_date, department, position, salary, hire_date, resign_date, status FROM employee WHERE COALESCE(is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
AND employee_id = CAST(#{employeeId} AS BIGINT)
ORDER BY employee_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (employee_code, full_name, email, phone_number, gender, birth_date, department, position, salary, hire_date, resign_date, status) VALUES (#{employeeCode}, #{fullName}, #{email}, NULLIF(#{phoneNumber}, ''), NULLIF(#{gender}, ''), CAST(NULLIF(#{birthDate}, '') AS DATE), NULLIF(#{department}, ''), NULLIF(#{position}, ''), CAST(NULLIF(#{salary}, '') AS NUMERIC), CAST(#{hireDate} AS DATE), CAST(NULLIF(#{resignDate}, '') AS DATE), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{status}, ''), 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET employee_code = #{employeeCode}, full_name = #{fullName}, email = #{email}, phone_number = NULLIF(#{phoneNumber}, ''), gender = NULLIF(#{gender}, ''), birth_date = CAST(NULLIF(#{birthDate}, '') AS DATE), department = NULLIF(#{department}, ''), position = NULLIF(#{position}, ''), salary = CAST(NULLIF(#{salary}, '') AS NUMERIC), hire_date = CAST(#{hireDate} AS DATE), resign_date = CAST(NULLIF(#{resignDate}, '') AS DATE), status = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{status}, ''), 'ACTIVE'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = CAST(#{employeeId} AS BIGINT)
UPDATE employee SET is_deleted = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = CAST(#{employeeId} AS BIGINT)
